quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Six months to June 30, 2026 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 22,370 million (-2.7%), operating profit JPY 1,778 million (-53.7%), ordinary profit JPY 2,229 million (-41.2%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 1,677 million (-37.4%). Segments: Japan JPY 11,695 million (-3.0%), operating profit JPY 2,023 million (-27.8%) - metallurgical applications and EDM electrodes firm, semiconductor applications weak on market adjustment; US JPY 2,127 million (+2.7%); Europe JPY 2,587 million (-1.0%); Asia JPY 5,960 million (-4.4%), with semiconductor applications down in the US, Europe and Asia.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 22,370 million (-2.7%); Japan JPY 11,695 million (-3.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 orders and backlog (semi-annual report): orders received JPY 26,112 million (131.8% of the prior-year half) and order backlog JPY 16,760 million (133.6%) at June 30, 2026. Special graphite products orders JPY 12,257 million (139.2%), backlog JPY 8,399 million (155.2%); composite and other products orders JPY 9,215 million (132.0%), backlog JPY 6,286 million (117.0%); US backlog JPY 4,252 million (181.6%). The backlog includes JPY 2,383 million from part of an order from X Energy, LLC for high-temperature gas-cooled reactor graphite products. Advances received rose JPY 2,656 million from the year-end. Production JPY 22,996 million (95.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: Orders JPY 26,112 million (131.8%); backlog JPY 16,760 million (133.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis (semi-annual report): Si and SiC semiconductor applications stayed sluggish in H1 on continued wafer inventory adjustment, but toward the end of the half demand expanded across a wide range of AI-related fields and EV demand began a moderate recovery on the energy price surge, so the inventory adjustment ran its course and the company's orders increased - management states bright signs have begun to appear. By product: special graphite products +4.2% (general industrial +9.9% on firm continuous casting and industrial furnace demand); composite and other products -13.7%, with C/C composites and graphite sheets above the prior-year half; general carbon products +7.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: Special graphite +4.2%; composite and other -13.7%; general carbon +7.7%

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex plan changes (semi-annual report): Production Technology Center (Kanonji, Kagawa) manufacturing-equipment expansion now JPY 2,968 million, JPY 2,947 million paid, completion moved from June 2026 to November 2026; Toyo Tanso USA (Troutdale, Oregon) expansion JPY 657 million, JPY 563 million paid, completion moved from July 2026 to December 2026. H1 R&D spending JPY 652 million; in April 2026 the company opened a carbon recycling design joint research chair at Gifu University and is researching new carbon raw-material sources with other industries to stabilise its future supply chain.
quarterly_data.figure: Production Technology Center JPY 2,968 million, completion November 2026; R&D JPY 652 million
